meaning:
περι-δέω
[in LXX: Job.12:18 (אָסַר)* ;]
to tie round, bind round: with accusative and dative, pass., Jhn.11:44.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”
